subject: Life Skills
title: The Gift of Fear
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Gift of Fear.

hook.text: Gavin de Becker wrote that true fear is a survival signal. Anxiety is not. Knowing the difference can save you.

buildup.text: Your subconscious detects danger faster than your conscious mind. That gut feeling is data, not irrationality.

discovery.text: When something feels wrong, your brain has already processed dozens of micro-cues you cannot articulate yet.

twist.text: Politeness overrides fear. People ignore gut warnings because they do not want to seem rude or paranoid.

climax.text: Give yourself permission to act on discomfort. Leave the elevator, cross the street, or say no with no reason given.

punchline.text: Your gut noticed before you did. Trust it.

quiz.question: Why do people often ignore their gut feeling about danger?
options: Politeness and social pressure override survival instincts
True danger is always obvious, not subtle
